english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for adding something else or saying that there is more in addition.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for adding another fact or point.
Use 仲有 to introduce an additional point in the sense of “besides” or “moreover.”

examples.english: I bought bread and, besides, some milk.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 min6 baau1 zung6 jau5 ngau4 naai5

examples.english: Moreover, it's going to rain tomorrow.
examples.jyutping: zung6 jau5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 lok6 jyu5

examples.english: Besides, we have to hand in the homework again today.
examples.traditional: 仲有，今日要再交一次功課。
examples.jyutping: zung6 jau5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 zoi3 gaau1 jat1 ci3 gung1 fo3
